objective: Census of not-all-equal relations (exhaustive n <= 6, sampled n = 7): is the map from a relation to its pairwise bond-distance table injective, unsigned, signed, and with the full bond set? Report collisions and the smallest example.
status: Supported 2026-11-17 (refereed R1, corrected): census of every NAE base at n = 4, 5, 6 and 258,384 sampled at n = 7: pairwise bond distance fails at n = 4 (12 tables for 16 relations), signed ties and bond sets fail at n = 5; bonds with their excluded joint states determine every relation tested only with two-place ties counted as bonds (883 / 1,023 at n = 5 without, referee); the referee's differ count determines every relation tested; 4 of 5 predictions held (D4 failed), control clean. At n = 6 a relation does not determine its knot set (pre-registration's claim false, referee).
title: Do bond-distance tables determine not-all-equal relations
